# Concepts

* [Natural-TEMPLATE conventions](conventions.md) - Controller property naming (p., c., e.) that Natural-TEMPLATE turns into components, communicators and event bindings before init, and how to install and activate it.
* [e.{id}.{event} event binding](event-binding.md) - How Natural-TEMPLATE binds e.{id}.{event} Controller properties as jQuery event handlers, including delegated handlers with a row index for N.grid and N.list rows.
* [p.{component}.{id} declarations](component-declaration.md) - How Natural-TEMPLATE turns p.{component}.{id} Controller properties into Natural-UI component instances, including p.select code and list binding, usage and action.
